title: 條垛堆肥通風控制
summary: 本課以「用空間氧氣、水分與溫度資料調整條垛堆肥通風」為主軸，依序處理條垛原料碳氮分層、翻堆與可通氣孔隙、強制通風能耗、冬夏顯熱交換、露天雨水與滲出水收支。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Use spatial oxygen, moisture and temperature evidence to assess windrow aeration, progressing through Windrow carbon-nitrogen heterogeneity, Turning and aeratable porosity, Forced-aeration energy, Seasonal sensible-heat exchange, Outdoor rainfall and leachate balance. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.

steps.instruction: 條垛不是均質容器，混料紀錄應保留各區原料比例，避免平均比值掩蓋局部差異。 混合碳氮比由碳總質量除以氮總質量；各原料碳氮比的算術平均一般不成立。

steps.title: 雨後含水調整：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Moisture after rainfall: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 雨後含水調整 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Moisture after rainfall and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 雨水可增加表層含水，核心仍可能偏乾；採樣位置需隨深度記錄。 以水質量守恆求混料量；混合後總重量也改變，所以不能直接相減含水率。
steps.instructionEn: Rain wets surface layers while cores may remain dry; record sampling depth and position. Use water-mass conservation to size a blend; total mass also changes, so subtracting moisture percentages is insufficient.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：濕料 m=1000 kg；含水率 w=0.70；調理料含水率 wb=0.20；目標 wt=0.55。公式 m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb)，計算得 428.571 kg。適用邊界：無蒸發、無反應、濕基分率；兩種原料混合，不代表實際最佳堆肥含水率。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Wet feed m=1000 kg; moisture w=0.70; bulking-agent moisture wb=0.20; target wt=0.55. Formula m_b=m*(w-wt)/(wt-wb) gives 428.571 kg. Applicability: No evaporation or reaction, wet-basis fractions and two feedstocks; the target is not an operational compost optimum.
steps.failure: 調理料本身很濕，卻仍用乾料假設計算，會低估需要量。 在「雨後含水調整」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
